corrections.text: The article attributes the quote "appear to be planning to replace human workers with new technologies" to both Benzinga and Gizmodo. The quote is accurate and appears in Benzinga's report (which credits it to Reuters), but it does not appear in the cited Gizmodo article. The quote should have been attributed to Benzinga only.

The article states Hyundai "agreed to buy SoftBank Group's remaining roughly 10% stake in Boston Dynamics" "days before the strike began." The strike ran July 13-15, 2026. Benzinga, the source cited for this figure, reports the deal was announced "in a press release on Thursday" -- July 16, 2026, the day after the strike ended, not days before it began.
